why: Shutterflow desktop-v3 is built screen by screen next to apps/desktop; gated by the G3 freeze.
what: The photos B (detail inspector aside, actions, context menu) port: files named in owns and their tests. Viewer and compare are v3-sf-photos-c.
contract: Read basalt-ui docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 6.4, shutterflow docs/decisions/0028-visual-regression-gate.md (no bulk baseline regeneration) and AGENTS.md safety rule 1 (photo inputs are the owner's; never read /Volumes). basalt-ui is pinned exact next.N (the gate's floor, v3-sf-bump in `after`): its docs/recipes and llms.txt are the API truth; never edit package.json or bun.lock. Aside law: shell-nav-router S8.
exemplar: The landed v3-sf-shell frame (apps/desktop-v3/src/shell) and the playground exemplars in the basalt-ui repo; old code under apps/desktop/src/features/.
change: Port the detail inspector over DetailSidebar sections, actions (judgement-model, unlock-and-apply, TagPicker, keyword suggestions, failure toast on notify) and the context menu on ui/menu. Spike S8 (decided here): ship the flex-sibling inspector in app code, 320 px, as the default. The PageAside claim (dock="always", main at least 480 px at window widths 900, 1024 and 1200 with the rail expanded and collapsed) is owner-run e2e: only if it confirms is a follow-up commit switching to PageAside. Rule: the app preset passes without new waivers. Skill snippet: none; recipes: the installed docs/recipes.
commits: Shutterflow ships by push to master: conventional, one concern each, no attribution. Never edit node_modules or basalt-ui; a gap is a `friction:` line in the PR body.
proof: hygiene.check is false: the factory cannot run `make check` or `make e2e`. Gate: the app's typecheck, test and build; state e2e and visual runs not-run (owner-run at cutover). `make check-changed` runs only without a package.json, bun.lock or Makefile change (else `make check`): state it not-run then.
acceptance: `bun run --filter @shutterflow/desktop-v3 typecheck`, `... test` and `... build` exit 0
`make check-changed` exits 0 (not-run if package.json, bun.lock or the Makefile changed: `make check` then)

`bun scripts/check-port.ts apps/desktop/src/features/photos/detail apps/desktop-v3/src/features/photos/detail` exits 0 (tests only, imports stripped; any other changed line carries a `// port: <reason>` marker, listed in the PR); the same for photos/actions and photos/context-menu

a DOM test mounts the detail inspector once at the default viewport and again after the testing kit's viewport setter sets 900, 1024 and 1200 (installed docs/testing.md; if the kit has no setter, the three-width check is owner-run and the PR says so)
the PR body states the S8 default taken (flex-sibling inspector) and that the 480 px measurement is owner-run
out_of_scope: Other screens, shell code, apps/desktop, e2e files (v3-sf-e2e-rekey), src-tauri.
